$comment: Third-party runtime assets the prototype pages load from unpkg.com, pinned.
The prototype is bundler-less: six pages under prototype/ and pwa/ pull React,
ReactDOM, Babel Standalone and pdf.js from the CDN at runtime and transpile JSX
in the browser. That is ~5.5 MB per page load, so a 53-test visual run made
150+ CDN requests and got throttled partway through — the scripts then failed,
React never mounted, and specs failed before reaching their screenshot
assertion. The visual suite therefore serves these from a local cache.
This file is DATA read by two consumers that cannot import each other:
`npm run test:regression:vendor` fails if a page requests something absent
here, so this list and the pages cannot drift apart silently.
